acetylene.title: Acetylene (C2H2)
acetylene.description: Acetylene gas for metal welding and cutting
acetylene.fullDescription: Acetylene (C2H2) is a highly flammable hydrocarbon gas widely used in the metal welding and cutting industry. This gas has an extremely high flame temperature, reaching 3,100°C, making it ideal for oxy-acetylene welding and metal cutting. Acetylene is also used in chemical synthesis to produce chemicals such as plastics, synthetic rubber, and fibers. PT Surya Inti Gas provides high-quality acetylene that meets industry standards for safety and optimal performance.

oxygen.title: Oxygen (O2)
oxygen.description: Oxygen gas for medical, metallurgical, and industrial applications
oxygen.fullDescription: Oxygen (O2) is a critical gas across a wide range of industrial and medical applications. In healthcare, oxygen is used for respiratory therapy, resuscitation, and as a supporting gas in anesthesia. In industry, oxygen plays a key role in metallurgical combustion and metal refining, in the chemical industry for oxidation, and in welding and metal cutting. Oxygen is also used in water treatment, paper manufacturing, and various other manufacturing processes. PT Surya Inti Gas supplies oxygen at purity levels tailored to each customer's specific needs.

nitrogen.title: Nitrogen (N2)
nitrogen.description: Nitrogen gas for inerting, blanketing, and cooling
nitrogen.fullDescription: Nitrogen (N2) is an inert gas that makes up about 78% of the earth's atmosphere. In industry, nitrogen is widely used for inerting (removing oxygen to prevent corrosion and explosions), blanketing (protecting liquid and solid products from oxidation), and cooling (cryogenic cooling). Nitrogen is also used in the food industry for preservation, in electronics for semiconductor manufacturing, and in metallurgy for heat-treatment processes. PT Surya Inti Gas supplies nitrogen in various forms and purity levels to suit your industrial application needs.

argon.title: Argon (Ar)
argon.description: Argon gas for TIG welding and electronics applications
argon.fullDescription: Argon (Ar) is an inert gas most commonly used in TIG (Tungsten Inert Gas) and MIG welding for its ability to shield the weld area from atmospheric contamination. This gas is also used in the electronics industry for semiconductor and display panel manufacturing, in metallurgy for heat-treatment processes, and in the glass industry for producing high-quality glass. Argon is also used in laboratory analysis as a carrier gas and in the protection of precious metals. PT Surya Inti Gas supplies high-purity argon for a wide range of precision industrial applications.

carbon-dioxide.title: Carbon Dioxide (CO2)
carbon-dioxide.description: CO2 gas for food, beverage, and industrial applications
carbon-dioxide.fullDescription: Carbon Dioxide (CO2) is a gas widely used in various industries. In the food and beverage industry, CO2 is used for beverage carbonation, food preservation, and cooling. In industry, CO2 is used for fire suppression, welding, and as a raw material in chemical processes. CO2 is also used in agriculture for greenhouses and in medical applications for various procedures. PT Surya Inti Gas supplies CO2 in food grade and industrial grade quality according to your application needs.

hydrogen.title: Hydrogen (H2)
hydrogen.description: Hydrogen gas for various industrial and energy applications
hydrogen.fullDescription: Hydrogen (H2) is the lightest and most abundant gas in the universe. In industry, hydrogen is used in petroleum refining, ammonia production, methanol manufacturing, and various other chemical processes. Hydrogen is also used as a fuel for fuel-cell-powered vehicles, in the electronics industry for semiconductor manufacturing, and as a carrier gas in gas chromatography analysis. PT Surya Inti Gas supplies hydrogen at purity levels suited to industrial and energy applications.

helium.title: Helium (He)
helium.description: Helium gas for medical, industrial, and research applications
helium.fullDescription: Helium (He) is the second-lightest inert gas after hydrogen. It has a wide range of important applications: in healthcare it is used for MRI (Magnetic Resonance Imaging), in industry for welding and leak detection, in scientific research for superconductor cooling, and for filling balloons and blimps. Helium is also used in the electronics industry for optical fiber and semiconductor manufacturing. PT Surya Inti Gas supplies high-purity helium for a wide range of medical, industrial, and research applications.

sulfur-hexaflouride.title: Sulfur Hexaflouride (SF6)
sulfur-hexaflouride.description: SF6 gas for electrical insulation and industrial applications
sulfur-hexaflouride.fullDescription: Sulfur hexafluoride (SF6) is a highly effective dielectric gas with excellent electrical insulation properties. It is widely used in the electrical industry as an insulating medium for switchgear, circuit breakers, and transformers. SF6 is also used in leak-detection applications, in the magnesium industry for casting, and in plasma-etching processes for semiconductor manufacturing. PT Surya Inti Gas supplies high-quality SF6 for electrical insulation and other industrial applications.

mixed-gas.title: Mixed Gas
mixed-gas.description: Custom gas mixtures for specific industrial applications
mixed-gas.fullDescription: Mixed Gas is a combination of various gases specially formulated for specific industrial applications. These mixtures include calibration gases for measuring instruments, process gases for manufacturing industries, shielding gases for welding, and medical gas mixtures for healthcare applications. Each mixture is designed with a precise composition to meet each customer's specific needs. PT Surya Inti Gas supplies a wide range of mixed gases with compositions tailored to your application requirements.

cradle-2x2.title: Cradle (2x2)
cradle-2x2.description: 2x2 cradle rack for gas cylinder storage
cradle-2x2.fullDescription: The 2x2 cradle is a gas cylinder storage system with a capacity of 4 cylinders (2 rows x 2 columns). This cradle is designed for space efficiency and easy cylinder handling. Suitable for industrial facilities that require a continuous gas supply at small to moderate capacity. PT Surya Inti Gas supplies the 2x2 cradle with locking systems and safety features.

cradle-3x2.title: Cradle (3x2)
cradle-3x2.description: 3x2 cradle rack for gas cylinder storage
cradle-3x2.fullDescription: The 3x2 cradle is a gas cylinder storage system with a capacity of 6 cylinders (3 rows x 2 columns). This cradle is designed for space efficiency and easy cylinder handling. Suitable for industrial facilities that require a continuous gas supply at moderate capacity. PT Surya Inti Gas supplies the 3x2 cradle with locking systems and safety features.

cradle-3x3.title: Cradle (3x3)
cradle-3x3.description: 3x3 cradle rack for gas cylinder storage
cradle-3x3.fullDescription: The 3x3 cradle is a gas cylinder storage system with a capacity of 9 cylinders (3 rows x 3 columns). This cradle is designed for space efficiency and easy cylinder handling. Suitable for industrial facilities that require a continuous gas supply at medium capacity. PT Surya Inti Gas supplies the 3x3 cradle with locking systems and safety features.

cradle-4x4.title: Cradle (4x4)
cradle-4x4.fullDescription: The 4x4 cradle is a gas cylinder storage system with a capacity of 16 cylinders (4 rows x 4 columns). This cradle is designed for industrial facilities with high gas consumption. The system maximizes storage capacity with an efficient footprint. PT Surya Inti Gas supplies the 4x4 cradle with sturdy construction and a complete safety system.

cylinder.title: Cylinder
cylinder.fullDescription: Gas cylinders are pressurized containers for storing and distributing industrial and medical gases. Available in various sizes and capacities to suit application needs. Gas cylinders are designed with high-quality materials and secure locking systems. PT Surya Inti Gas supplies various types of gas cylinders for industrial, medical, and laboratory applications.

cryogenic-dewars.title: Cryogenic Dewars
cryogenic-dewars.description: Cryogenic dewars for liquid gas storage
cryogenic-dewars.fullDescription: Cryogenic dewars are vacuum-insulated containers for storing liquid gas at extremely low temperatures. These dewars use vacuum insulation technology to maintain cryogenic temperatures and minimize evaporation. Available in various capacities for laboratory, industrial, and medical needs. PT Surya Inti Gas supplies cryogenic dewars with high safety standards and thermal efficiency.

vessel-gas-liquid.title: Vessel Gas Liquid
vessel-gas-liquid.fullDescription: A liquid gas vessel is a large-capacity tank for storing liquid gas over extended periods. This vessel is designed with a thermal insulation system and safety features to prevent evaporation and maintain gas quality. Suitable for industrial facilities with high gas consumption. PT Surya Inti Gas supplies liquid gas vessels with specifications tailored to operational needs.

microbulk-tank.title: Microbulk Tank
microbulk-tank.description: Microbulk tank for continuous gas supply
microbulk-tank.fullDescription: A microbulk tank is an efficient continuous gas supply solution for facilities with medium gas consumption. This system combines the convenience of cylinders with the efficiency of bulk supply. Microbulk tanks reduce the frequency of refilling and cylinder handling. PT Surya Inti Gas supplies microbulk tanks with scheduled monitoring and delivery systems.

vertical-storage-tank.title: Vertical Storage Tank
vertical-storage-tank.fullDescription: A vertical storage tank is a liquid gas storage solution with an elongated design for space efficiency. This tank is suitable for facilities with limited space that require large storage capacity. The vertical design minimizes footprint while providing maximum capacity. PT Surya Inti Gas supplies vertical storage tanks that meet strict industrial safety standards.

iso-tank.title: ISO Tank
iso-tank.fullDescription: A cryogenic ISO tank is an internationally standardized container for transporting liquid gas at extremely low temperatures. This tank meets ISO standards for multimodal transport (road, sea, air) and is equipped with advanced vacuum insulation systems. Suitable for distributing liquid gas across countries or long distances. PT Surya Inti Gas supplies cryogenic ISO tanks with international certification and monitoring systems.

lorry-tank.title: Cryogenic Rigged Tank
lorry-tank.fullDescription: A cryogenic rigged tank is a specialized vehicle for distributing liquid gas by road. This tank is designed with efficient thermal insulation to maintain cryogenic temperatures during transit. Suitable for distributing liquid gas between industrial facilities and consumption sites. PT Surya Inti Gas provides liquid gas distribution services with a rigged tank fleet that meets safety standards.

installation.title: Installation
installation.fullDescription: Industrial gas system installation service includes planning, installation, and commissioning of gas systems for industrial and medical facilities. Our experienced technicians install pipelines, manifolds, regulators, and gas safety systems. We ensure installation meets international safety standards and the specific operational needs of customers. PT Surya Inti Gas provides installation services with quality assurance and technical support.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.description: Gas delivery service to customer locations
delivery.fullDescription: Our gas delivery service includes distribution of gas cylinders, bulk liquid gas, and cryogenic tanks to customer locations throughout Indonesia. Our fleet is equipped with safety systems and monitoring to ensure safe and timely delivery. We provide delivery schedules that can be customized to customer operational needs. PT Surya Inti Gas guarantees efficient and reliable delivery.

refilling.title: Refilling
refilling.description: Cylinder and tank gas refilling service
refilling.fullDescription: Gas refilling service includes refill of industrial and medical gas cylinders, as well as filling of bulk liquid tanks and cryogenic vessels. Our refilling facilities are equipped with modern equipment and quality control systems to ensure gas purity and safety. We provide on-site refilling and exchange systems for operational efficiency. PT Surya Inti Gas guarantees consistent gas quality for every refill.

2003.title: Founding

2007.title: Operational Expansion

2016.title: Moving to the Head Office

2017.title: Transformation and Expansion
2017.description: The company officially transformed from CV. Surya Inti Gas into PT. Surya Inti Gas. In the same year, the company expanded its service reach by opening its first branch in Balikpapan, East Kalimantan, as a strategic step to serve customers in eastern Indonesia.

industrial-plant-1.title: Industrial Plant
industrial-plant-1.detailedDescription: PT Surya Inti Gas's industrial plant is equipped with modern production facilities that meet international safety and quality standards. This facility has the production capacity to meet industrial gas needs throughout Indonesia. With advanced technology and strict quality control processes, we ensure every gas product produced has consistent quality and meets specifications.

welding-1.title: Welding Process
welding-1.detailedDescription: The welding process using industrial gas is one of the main applications of PT Surya Inti Gas's products. Our gases are widely used in the construction, manufacturing, and automotive industries to produce high-quality welds. We supply various types of welding gas to suit specific welding process needs, including acetylene, argon, and other gas mixtures.

lab-1.title: Gas Laboratory
lab-1.detailedDescription: PT Surya Inti Gas's gas laboratory is equipped with modern analytical equipment to ensure the quality and purity of every gas product. Our team of experts conducts routine testing to verify gas composition, detect contamination, and ensure compliance with industry standards. This laboratory facility is a vital part of our quality control system.

delivery-1.title: Gas Delivery
delivery-1.detailedDescription: PT Surya Inti Gas's delivery fleet consists of specialized vehicles designed for safe gas transport. Each unit is equipped with the most advanced safety systems and operated by an experienced team. Our distribution network covers all of Indonesia, ensuring timely gas delivery to customer locations with the highest safety standards.

tank-1.title: Storage Tank
tank-1.detailedDescription: The large-capacity liquid gas storage tank is a vital facility in PT Surya Inti Gas's operations. This tank is designed to store large volumes of liquid gas while maintaining optimal temperature and pressure. Our storage system is equipped with dual safety features and 24-hour monitoring to ensure a continuous gas supply to customers.

valve-1.title: Gas Valve
valve-1.description: Valve system for gas flow control
valve-1.detailedDescription: PT Surya Inti Gas's gas valve system uses high-quality components for precise gas flow control. Our valves are designed to withstand high pressure and demanding operating conditions. Each unit is equipped with automatic safety features and regularly inspected to ensure optimal performance in regulating gas flow to various industrial applications.

hospital-1.title: Hospital Gas System
hospital-1.detailedDescription: PT Surya Inti Gas's hospital gas system is specially designed for medical needs with the highest safety standards. We provide medical gas installations covering oxygen, nitrogen, and other medical gases for hospitals and healthcare facilities. Our system meets health regulations and is equipped with automatic safety features for the comfort of patients and medical staff.

quality-1.title: Quality Control
quality-1.description: Quality control process for gas products
quality-1.detailedDescription: PT Surya Inti Gas's quality control process is carried out thoroughly at every stage of production. From raw materials to finished products, every stage is inspected to ensure compliance with quality standards. Our QC system uses the latest analytical technology and is run by a certified team to guarantee consistent, reliable product quality.

training-1.title: Safety Training
training-1.detailedDescription: PT Surya Inti Gas's occupational safety training program is designed to ensure employee competency in handling gas safely. Training covers emergency response, safety procedures, and the use of personal protective equipment. Every employee must pass certification before being allowed to work with gas, ensuring the highest safety standards in our operations.

pressure-gauge-1.title: Pressure Gauge
pressure-gauge-1.detailedDescription: The pressure gauge is a vital measuring device in PT Surya Inti Gas's gas systems. We use high-accuracy calibrated pressure gauges to monitor gas pressure in real time. Each device is routinely calibrated and inspected to ensure accurate readings, supporting the safety and operational efficiency of our gas distribution.

factory-1.title: Factory Floor
factory-1.detailedDescription: PT Surya Inti Gas's factory floor is designed with an efficient and safe workflow system. The production area is equipped with ventilation systems, gas detection, and strict safety procedures. Each production area has clearly defined zones for different processes, ensuring an organized production flow and minimizing the risk of cross-contamination between products.

medical-equipment-1.title: Medical Equipment
medical-equipment-1.detailedDescription: Medical equipment using gas from PT Surya Inti Gas meets international health standards. We supply gas for various medical equipment including ventilators, anesthesia machines, and hospital oxygen systems. Every medical gas product we produce has the high purity and certification required for use in healthcare facilities.

cryogenic-1.title: Cryogenic System
cryogenic-1.detailedDescription: PT Surya Inti Gas's cryogenic system uses advanced technology to store liquid gas at extremely low temperatures. This system maintains gas in liquid form with maximum efficiency, enabling large-volume storage in a compact space. Our cryogenic facility is equipped with dual safety systems and 24-hour temperature monitoring for operational safety.

assembly-1.title: Assembly Line
assembly-1.detailedDescription: PT Surya Inti Gas's gas cylinder assembly line uses both automated and manual processes to ensure the quality of every cylinder. Each cylinder undergoes a series of quality tests, including pressure and leak tests, before being approved for distribution. Our assembly line is designed for high production efficiency without compromising safety and quality standards.

fire-safety-1.title: Fire Safety
fire-safety-1.detailedDescription: PT Surya Inti Gas's fire safety system is designed to gas industry safety standards. Our facilities are equipped with automatic fire detection systems, hydrants, and easily accessible fire extinguishers. Fire drills and emergency response training are conducted routinely to ensure our team is ready to respond to emergencies quickly and effectively.

transport-1.title: Gas Transport
transport-1.detailedDescription: PT Surya Inti Gas's gas transport vehicles are specially designed to safely carry various types of gas. Each vehicle is equipped with a GPS system, leak sensors, and compartments that meet hazardous gas transport standards. Our drivers hold special certification and follow strict safety procedures for every delivery.

laboratory-2.title: Chemistry Lab
laboratory-2.detailedDescription: PT Surya Inti Gas's chemistry lab supports research and development of new gas products. This facility is equipped with modern analytical equipment for gas composition research, new formula development, and gas application testing. Our research team works continuously to improve product quality and discover innovative gas solutions for customers' industrial needs.

regulator-1.title: Gas Regulator
regulator-1.detailedDescription: PT Surya Inti Gas's gas regulator is designed for precise and safe gas pressure control. Our regulators are available in various capacities and types to suit industrial application needs. Each unit is equipped with safety features such as a relief valve and pressure gauge to ensure safe and efficient gas use at customer locations.

1.title: Sales Executive
1.description: Responsible for selling industrial gas products to new customers and maintaining relationships with existing customers.
1.fullDescription: The Sales Executive is responsible for growing the company's business by finding new customers and maintaining relationships with existing ones. This role includes product presentations, price negotiation, and achieving the sales targets set by the company.
requirements: Minimum D3/Bachelor's degree in any major
At least 2 years of experience in sales
Good communication and negotiation skills
Owns a personal vehicle and a Driver's License C
Able to work under targets and pressure
Based in Sidoarjo or surrounding areas

2.title: Installation Technician
2.description: Performs installation and maintenance of industrial gas systems, high-pressure cylinders, and related equipment at customer sites.
2.fullDescription: The Installation Technician is responsible for installing, maintaining, and troubleshooting industrial gas systems at customer sites. This role ensures all equipment functions properly and meets safety standards.
requirements: Minimum vocational high school (Mechanical/Electrical Engineering)
At least 2 years of experience in gas installation
Technical certification is an advantage
Able to read schematics and technical drawings
Willing to work in the field and travel
Understands occupational safety standards

3.title: Admin & Finance Staff
3.description: Handles financial administration and office operations, including bookkeeping, financial reports, and HR administration.
3.fullDescription: The Admin & Finance Staff is responsible for managing daily financial administration, bookkeeping, preparing financial reports, and basic HR administration. This role covers operational expenses, invoicing, and office documentation.
requirements: Minimum D3 in Accounting/Financial Management
Fresh graduates are welcome to apply
Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
Thorough and organized in administration
Able to work in a team or independently
Based in Balikpapan

4.title: Gas Delivery Driver
4.description: Responsible for delivering industrial gas to customer locations safely and on time according to the set schedule.
4.fullDescription: The Gas Delivery Driver is responsible for delivering industrial gas products to customer locations safely and on time. This role includes checking cylinder condition, delivering along the route, and delivery documentation.
requirements: Minimum high school diploma or equivalent
Holds a valid B1 driver's license
Minimum 3 years of truck driving experience
Familiar with Sidoarjo and surrounding routes
Honest, disciplined, and responsible
Willing to work in shifts

5.title: Quality Control Engineer
5.description: Ensures industrial gas product quality meets standards and performs routine product testing.
5.fullDescription: The Quality Control Engineer is responsible for ensuring all industrial gas products meet established quality standards. This role includes product testing, production process inspection, and QC result documentation.
requirements: Minimum Bachelor's degree in Chemical/Industrial Engineering
At least 2 years of experience in Quality Control
Understands ISO standards and gas industry regulations
Able to analyze data and prepare QC reports
Thorough and detail-oriented in inspections
Willing to work in the production area

6.title: Marketing Specialist
6.description: Develops marketing strategies and promotes industrial gas products to the target market.
6.fullDescription: The Marketing Specialist is responsible for developing and implementing marketing strategies for industrial gas products. This role includes market research, digital marketing, event management, and campaign analysis.
requirements: Minimum Bachelor's degree in Marketing/Communications
At least 2 years of experience in marketing
Proficient in digital marketing and social media
Good market analysis skills
Creative in producing marketing content
Based in Balikpapan

7.title: Warehouse Supervisor
7.description: Manages warehouse operations, inventory, and coordination of gas product distribution.
7.fullDescription: The Warehouse Supervisor is responsible for managing all warehouse operations including receiving, storage, picking, packing, and shipping. This role includes team management, inventory control, and coordination with other departments.
requirements: Minimum D3/Bachelor's degree in Management/Logistics
At least 5 years of experience in warehousing
At least 3 years of experience leading a team
Proficient in inventory management systems
Forklift certification is an advantage
Able to prepare inventory reports and KPIs

8.title: HR Manager
8.description: Manages recruitment, employee development, and the company's human resources policies.
8.fullDescription: The HR Manager is responsible for the full range of HR functions including recruitment, training & development, compensation & benefits, employee relations, and HR operations. This role includes developing HR policies and implementing HR strategy.
requirements: Minimum Bachelor's degree in Psychology/Law/HR Management
At least 5 years of experience in HR
At least 3 years of experience leading an HR team
Understands Indonesian labor regulations
Strong leadership and communication skills
Based in Balikpapan

9.title: Safety Officer
9.description: Ensures compliance with occupational safety standards in industrial gas operations.
9.fullDescription: The Safety Officer is responsible for ensuring compliance with occupational health and safety (HSE) standards across all company operations. This role includes safety inspections, accident investigations, HSE training, and safety program implementation.
requirements: Minimum D3 in Occupational Health & Safety/Environmental Engineering
Holds a General/Industrial HSE Expert certification
At least 3 years of experience in HSE
Understands HSE regulations and related laws
Able to conduct safety audits and risk assessments
Willing to work in operational areas

salesExecutive.title: Sales Executive – Industrial Gas
salesExecutive.description: Responsible for industrial gas sales to manufacturing and processing clients. Build long-term relationships with customers and achieve monthly targets.
requirements: D3/Bachelor's degree in any major
Minimum 2 years B2B sales experience
Have personal vehicle & Driver's License A/C
Communicative and target-oriented

installationTechnician.title: Gas Installation Technician
installationTechnician.description: Perform gas pipe installation, regulator installation, and commissioning of gas distribution systems at industrial and medical client locations.
requirements: SMK Technical / D3 Mechanical or related
Understand piping and fitting systems
General Occupational Safety Certificate (preferred)
Willing to work in the field

adminFinanceStaff.title: Administration & Finance Staff
adminFinanceStaff.description: Manage daily administration, simple bookkeeping, and coordination of company operational documents.
requirements: D3/Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Management
Master Microsoft Office (Excel advanced)
Detail-oriented, neat, and responsible
1 year administration experience (preferred)

gasDeliveryDriver.description: Responsible for timely and safe delivery of gas cylinders to customers, and maintaining vehicle fleet condition.
requirements: Have active Driver's License B1/B2
Experience driving commercial vehicles
Understand delivery safety procedures
